text.es: Fina: Marta, escúchame, sé lo que estás pensando. Por favor. La visita de Bianca no significa nada para mí, nada. Entre nosotras todo va a seguir igual. Marta: Sabes que no está en España por trabajos...Ha venido a Toledo por ti. Fina: No puedes comparar, nuestra historia no tiene nada que ver con la suya. Vamos, es que aterricé en España y me bastó con verte para saber que estaba enamorada de ti.
text.en: Fina: Marta, listen to me, I know what you're thinking. Please. Bianca's visit means nothing to me, nothing. Between us everything is going to stay the same. Marta: You know she's not in Spain for work... She came to Toledo for you. Fina: You can't compare, our story has nothing to do with hers. Come on, I landed in Spain and one look at you was enough to know that I was in love with you.
